data.one_liner: Extended image library with caching, placeholders, zoom/pan, slide-out, and crop editor.
data.what_it_does: Extends Flutter's Image component to support loading and failed states, network caching, zoom and pan gestures, slide-out page transitions, and an image editor with crop, rotate, and flip capabilities.
use_when: You need advanced image features like zoom, pan, or built-in crop and edit tools.
You require robust caching and placeholder/failed states for network images.
avoid_when: You only need basic local or network image rendering without extra gestures or editing.
You want a minimal, lightweight footprint and do not need complex image interactions.
strengths: Rich feature set including caching, custom load states, and gesture zoom/pan.
Built-in image editor supporting cropping, rotating, flipping, undo, and redo.
Supports slide-out page transitions for images.
weaknesses: Large scope and dependency tree compared to basic image widgets.
Has introduced breaking changes across major version upgrades.

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a modular approach to placeholders and error widgets.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need to pick images from the device gallery or camera.

data.minimal_example:
ExtendedImage.network(
  url,
  width: 400,
  height: 400,
  fit: BoxFit.fill,
  cache: true,
  border: Border.all(color: Colors.red, width: 1.0),
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(30.0)),
)
